video.title: Synthetic: Why You Get Crowded (self-test fixture, not a real episode)

problem.title_as_question: Why do I get crowded at contact?
problem.definition: The ball ends up too close to the body at contact.

quotes.text: a lot of players set up with the ball far too close to their right hip
quotes.speaker: coach

quotes.text: the arm folds up and the elbow ends up stuck against the ribs
quotes.speaker: coach

quotes.text: they walk straight at the ball instead of leaving space off to the side
quotes.speaker: coach

quotes.text: watch Sam here, his feet stop moving early and he ends up crowded at contact
quotes.speaker: coach

quotes.text: ask him to stand right on top of the ball on purpose
quotes.speaker: coach

quotes.text: the ball is almost uncomfortably far away to your right
quotes.speaker: coach

quotes.text: put a cone half a step outside your contact point and try to hit the ball outside the cone
quotes.speaker: coach

quotes.text: if the ball keeps landing short and you feel crowded you are still too close
quotes.speaker: coach

quotes.text: here is Sam doing it well, plenty of space and a long smooth swing
quotes.speaker: coach

symptoms.description: elbow stuck against the ribs at contact
ball lands short, player feels crowded

causes.statement: ball set up too close to the right hip
walking straight at the ball, no space left to the side

solutions.summary: cone half a step outside contact
solutions.external_goal: 让球在锥桶外侧被击中

solutions.summary: short balls plus crowded feel means still too close
